---
title: "easydta: single-test DTA meta-analysis (CT)"
output: html_document
---

```{r packages}
if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("pacman")
}
if (!requireNamespace("remotes", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("remotes")
}
if (!requireNamespace("easydta", quietly = TRUE)) {
  remotes::install_github("vanioljantunes/easydta")
}
pacman::p_load(ggplot2, grid, gridExtra)
library(easydta)
```

```{r load_data}
path <- system.file("extdata/ct_single.csv", package = "easydta")
d <- utils::read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
head(d)
```

```{r fit}
fit <- dta_fit_single(d, nAGQ = 1, wide = TRUE,
                      tp = "TP", fp = "FP", fn = "FN", tn = "TN",
                      studlab = "studlab")
print(fit)
```

```{r save_forest}
png("forest_ct.png", width = 1400, height = 1000, res = 150)
dta_forest(fit)
dev.off()
```

```{r save_sroc}
png("sroc_ct.png", width = 1200, height = 1000, res = 150)
p <- dta_sroc(fit, auc_method = "trapz")
print(p)
dev.off()
```
